title: ‘Political activities like sit-ins, hunger strikes have no place in democracy’: Kerala HC

ai.summary: Kerala High Court ruled that political activities like sit-ins and hunger strikes have no place in academic institutions, stating educational institutions should not be used for politics.

facts.claim: Kerala High Court said that 'political activities' such as dharnas, or sit-ins, hunger strikes and satyagraha, or peaceful protests, have 'no place in a constitutional democracy', particularly in academic institutes
facts.quote: The Kerala High Court has said that “political activities” such as dharnas, or sit-ins, hunger strikes and satyagraha, or peaceful protests, have “no place in a constitutional democracy”, particularly in academic institutes

facts.claim: The Kerala High Court allowed 16 suspended students of the Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit to appear for their semester examinations
facts.quote: The Kerala High Court made the observation while setting aside a single-bench order that allowed 16 suspended students of the Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit in Ernakulam district to appear for their semester examinations.

facts.claim: The students were suspended after protesting for better infrastructure and academic facilities and held a street play that allegedly insulted Vice Chancellor Ciza Thomas
facts.quote: The students, members of the Communist Party of India (Marxist)’s student wing, were suspended after they protested for better infrastructure and academic facilities, and held a street play that allegedly insulted Vice Chancellor Ciza Thomas in August.

facts.claim: The students had failed to meet the university’s attendance requirements as they had been suspended and approached the single-judge bench seeking permission to appear for their semester examinations
facts.quote: The students had failed to meet the university’s attendance requirements as they had been suspended and approached the single-judge bench seeking permission to appear for their semester examinations.

facts.claim: The division bench said allowing the students to take the examinations without meeting the university’s requirements would undermine its academic and disciplinary rules
facts.quote: The division bench said allowing the students to take the examinations without meeting the university’s requirements would undermine its academic and disciplinary rules.

facts.claim: Any students involved in 'political activities like dharna, hunger strikes or satyagraha' would be liable to being 'expelled and/or rusticated'
facts.quote: Any students involved in “political activities like dharna, hunger strikes or satyagraha” would be liable to being “expelled and/or rusticated”

facts.claim: Educational institutions are meant for imparting education and not politics
facts.quote: Educational institutions are meant for imparting education and not politics,
